name: Find Traps

targets.description: traps within range and line of sight

summary: Learn whether any trap lies within 120 feet and line of sight, and its general nature, but not where.
text: You sense whether any trap is within range and within your line of sight. For this spell, a trap is any object or mechanism made to cause damage or other danger, so it notices things like an Alarm or Glyph of Warding spell or a mechanical pit trap, but not natural hazards such as a weak floor, an unstable ceiling or a hidden sinkhole. You learn that a trap is present and the general nature of its danger, but not its location.
